title: Less than 2.5% of Taylor Farms' recalled lettuce went to Taco Bells
summary: The second-largest lot went to Taylor Farms’ own brand, which received 68,897 cases, a little over 29 percent. Sysco received 11,519 cases (4.9 percent), Markon got 7,459 cases (3.15 percent), and Peak Fresh Produce (Performance Foodservice) got 720 cases (0.3 percent).
